verdict.rationale: Dialpad publishes a public developer API with documented endpoints covering call control, contact center queueing, access policies, contact anonymization, recording removal, number blocking, and webhook listing. It also documents OAuth token generation and rate limits, ships a Python client library, and offers agent-friendly llms.txt and markdown docs that probes confirmed are live. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
